items: A work permit must be issued.

Personal protective equipment must be used (safety shoes, Helmet, breathing 
 mask, safety glasses).
Maintenance staff should be well trained and qualified.

Caution marks must be hanged on the work place, safety rope around the work 
 place.

Check the carbon brushes length during operation without removing the brush holder by inserting a gage 
 stick of insulating materials into the bore of the telescopic plunger. The gage stick is provided with 
 several notch marks showing the useful length of the carbon brush.

By visual inspection, make sure 
 that no spark (brushes are matched with slip rings).

Safety 
Precautions
A work permit must be issued.
Personal protective equipment must be used (safety shoes, Helmet, breathing 
 mask, safety glasses).
Maintenance staff should be well trained and qualified.
Caution marks must be hanged on the work place, safety rope around the work 
 place.
Tools 
and Equipment
Brushes measuring tool.
Blower.
Screw driver.
Work to be 
carried out
Check the carbon brushes.
Check the carbon brushes length during operation without removing the brush holder by inserting a gage 
 stick of insulating materials into the bore of the telescopic plunger. The gage stick is provided with 
 several notch marks showing the useful length of the carbon brush.
By visual inspection, make sure 
 that no spark (brushes are matched with slip rings).
